afterHoursMessage: Our team is currently offline. We'll reply on the next business day. You can still ask questions or start a loan application now and a representative will follow up.
interestAndFees: Interest starts at 3.5% per month. The exact rate and fees vary by loan type and repayment term.
requirements: Proof of income (a recent pay slip or bank statement)
No collateral required for loans under JMD $100,000
repaymentTerms: Repay weekly or monthly, with terms from 3 to 24 months.
howToApply: Share your full name, ID number, monthly income, and the loan amount you need. A representative reviews it and follows up.
approvalTime: Same-day approval for most applications. Approved funds are disbursed within 24 hours.

faq.a: No collateral is needed for loans under JMD $100,000. Larger loans may require collateral depending on the loan type.

faq.q: How fast can I get the money?

escalationMessage: Thanks! I've passed your details to our loan team. A representative will contact you shortly during business hours to continue your application.
toneGuidelines: Warm, clear, and professional. Use plain language. Keep replies short enough to read comfortably on WhatsApp (usually 2-5 sentences). Never promise approval or a specific rate - those depend on review.
